features.notes: Drawing/chart parts and relationships are retained when connectivity checks pass. A loaded workbook may rename a sheet and update qualified chart <c:f> references; bounded edits cover selected series formulas, caches, marker attributes, smooth flag, title, legend, axes, style, and data labels. Chart creation and general editing are not supported.

Pivot cache owner and reachable parts are preserved when validated. A loaded workbook may rename a sheet and update worksheetSource@sheet; general source/cache edits and pivot recalculation are not implemented.
Worksheet drawing and legacy-drawing owners are restored only when their relationships and reachable targets survive.
External URLs are never fetched or executed. External-reference owner XML may be preserved when its relationship is valid; external-reference formulas are not evaluated.
